system_design.overview: Implement a complete Option Chain feature for SmartTrade platform enabling traders to view live option chains, calculate and visualize Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega), track IV Rank/Percentile, build multi-leg option strategies, and calculate P&L for strategy positions. Architecture extends existing microservices pattern with a new Options Chain Service handling data aggregation, calculation, and streaming.
system_design.architecture_pattern: Microservices with Event-Driven Architecture. New Options Chain Service (OCS) coordinates option data from Broker Adapter Service (BAS), performs Greeks calculations, manages IV history, and publishes domain events. Frontend subscribes to WebSocket stream for real-time updates.

modules.name: Options Chain Service (OCS)
modules.responsibility: Core service handling option chain aggregation, Greeks calculation, IV metrics, strategy validation, and WebSocket streaming for live option data
dependencies: Broker Adapter Service (REST API for static data)
Market Data Service (WebSocket for underlying price updates)

modules.name: Greeks Calculator Engine
modules.responsibility: Compute and cache Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega using Black-Scholes model; handle volatility surface interpolation and edge cases

modules.name: IV Rank & Percentile Engine
modules.responsibility: Calculate IV Rank (current IV vs 52-week range) and IV Percentile (historical IV percentile) for all strikes; maintain rolling IV history

modules.name: Option Strategy Builder
modules.responsibility: Validate multi-leg option strategies (spreads, straddles, strangles, etc.), compute combined Greeks, calculate max profit/loss/risk, generate P&L payoff curves

modules.name: Option P&L Calculator
modules.responsibility: Calculate real-time P&L for open option positions and strategies based on current market prices; support Greeks-based P&L attribution

modules.name: Frontend Option Chain Components
modules.responsibility: React components for option chain table, Greeks heatmap, strategy builder UI, P&L visualization, and real-time price updates

modules.name: WebSocket Aggregator for Options
modules.responsibility: Broadcast option chain updates, Greeks changes, and strategy P&L changes to connected frontend clients in real-time

constraints: Use scipy.stats.norm for normal distribution (CDF, PDF)

execution_plan.title: Implement IV Rank & IV Percentile Calculation Engine
execution_plan.description: Build engine to calculate IV Rank (current IV / (52-week high IV - 52-week low IV)) and IV Percentile (% of historical IV values below current IV) for each strike. Store rolling IV history in database.
execution_plan.inputs: Historical IV data (52-week lookback), current IV from Fyers
execution_plan.outputs: IV metrics calculator, historical IV storage and retrieval, update job
interfaces: IVMetricsCalculator.calculate_iv_rank(symbol: str, strike: float, expiry: str, current_iv: float) -> float (0-100)
IVMetricsCalculator.calculate_iv_percentile(symbol: str, strike: float, expiry: str, current_iv: float) -> float (0-100)

IVHistoryRepository.get_historical_values(symbol: str, strike: float, expiry: str, days: int = 365) -> List[float]
constraints: IV Rank formula: (current_iv - min_52week_iv) / (max_52week_iv - min_52week_iv) * 100; return 0 if denominator = 0
IV Percentile: rank(current_iv in historical_values) / total_count * 100

Expire IV history after 18 months (to control DB size)
Handle missing IV values gracefully (skip, don't interpolate)
Partition IV history table by symbol and expiry for query performance
Concurrent updates to same strike/expiry must be serialized

execution_plan.title: Implement Option P&L Calculator for Positions & Strategies
execution_plan.description: Build real-time P&L calculator for open option positions and strategies. Support Greeks-based attribution, scenario analysis, and mark-to-market valuation.
execution_plan.inputs: Portfolio positions (from BAS), current market prices, Greeks, entry prices
execution_plan.outputs: P&L calculator service, Greeks attribution model, scenario P&L
interfaces: PositionPnL (dataclass): symbol, option_type, strike, quantity, entry_price, current_price, unrealized_pl, realized_pl, pl_percentage

constraints: P&L = (current_price - entry_price) * quantity for individual positions

Gamma P&L ≈ 0.5 * gamma * quantity * spot_move^2
Theta P&L ≈ theta * quantity * (days_passed / 365)
Vega P&L ≈ vega * quantity * iv_move_bps / 100

Memory usage: < 500MB per 100 concurrent connections
CPU usage: < 80% with 4 workers under expected load

1000 req/min API traffic processed without queue buildup

execution_plan.title: Security & Compliance Review for Option Chain Service
execution_plan.description: Conduct security audit covering API authentication/authorization, data validation, SQL injection prevention, XSS prevention, rate limiting, CORS, secret management, and compliance with SmartTrade security guidelines. Fix any findings before production deployment.
execution_plan.inputs: OWASP Top 10, SmartTrade security guidelines, security checklist
execution_plan.outputs: Security audit report, fixes for identified issues
interfaces: Security audit covers: API auth (Bearer tokens), input validation, error handling, secret management, CORS config, rate limiting, dependency vulnerabilities
constraints: All endpoints must require Bearer token authentication
Input validation: symbol alphanumeric, strike positive float, option_type in ['CE', 'PE']
No SQL injection: use parameterized queries (SQLAlchemy ORM handles this)
No XSS: frontend sanitizes all user input before rendering
Rate limiting: 100 req/min per user for regular endpoints
CORS: allow only trusted frontend domain
Secrets: JWT_SECRET_KEY, FYERS_APP_SECRET stored in environment variables, never in code
Dependency vulnerabilities: run 'uv audit', fix any HIGH/CRITICAL findings
acceptance_criteria: Security audit identifies 0 CRITICAL or HIGH severity issues
All findings are documented and fixed before production
API authentication/authorization verified for all endpoints
Input validation prevents SQL injection and XSS
Rate limiting enforced and tested
Secrets properly managed (no hardcoded values)
CORS configuration restricts access to trusted origins

global_constraints: Production-ready code only: no console.logs, no print() debug statements, no TODO comments
Follow clean architecture: separate concerns, dependency injection, testable code
Add comprehensive logging: use structlog (backend) and console.log with structured data (frontend)
Handle errors gracefully: return standardized SmartTradeError with error codes, log context
All async code: use AsyncIO backend and async/await patterns consistently
Type safety: strict typing in Python (use type hints), TypeScript strict mode in frontend
Database migrations: use Alembic for all schema changes, create migration for each step
Testing: min 80% code coverage, unit tests for algorithms, integration tests for APIs
Documentation: code comments for non-obvious logic, docstrings for functions, API docs auto-generated
Backwards compatibility: if changing existing schemas, include migration and deprecation period
Git commits: atomic, descriptive messages, one feature per commit
No hardcoded values: all configuration via environment variables or config files
Resilience: retry logic with exponential backoff, circuit breaker for external APIs, timeouts on all calls
Observability: log important events (startup, data refresh, API calls, errors), expose Prometheus metrics
